observations: Three photos show a large flat-screen TV displaying a colorful cityscape with floating balloons and a smart TV interface at the bottom.
The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible in the top right corner of the screen in all three photos.
The screen displays app icons including YouTube, Apple TV, Disney+, iVOLUS, Internet, BBC, and e-Manual, indicating a smart TV interface.
The TV is mounted on a wall or placed on a stand; the bezel is thin and black.
No physical model number or label is visible on the TV frame or back in any photo.
The screen appears to be working and displaying vibrant colors, with no visible dead pixels or damage in the provided images.
A watermark 'JEEP INTERNATIONAL' is overlaid on all photos, suggesting a reseller or distributor.

claims.claim: This beasty Samsung 75-inch tv is a QLED 4k Smart LED TV that displays brilliant picture quality
claims.evidence: The brand 'Samsung' and smart TV interface are visible, but there is no visual proof of QLED or 4K resolution. The screen looks vibrant, but 'brilliant picture quality' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The TV may not be QLED or 4K as claimed, or may be a lower-end model misrepresented as premium.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number on the back of the TV or on the settings menu screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard LED smart TV, not QLED 4K, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The TV may have physical damage, dead pixels, or screen burn-in not visible in the current display images.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV screen showing a solid white or black screen, or a close-up of the bezel and back panel for damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or with unknown screen condition, reducing value.

risks.risk: The TV may not be in working condition or may have software issues not visible in the current interface.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the TV turning on, changing inputs, and playing a video or test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number on the back of the TV or in the settings menu.
Photo of the TV screen displaying a solid white or black screen to check for dead pixels or burn-in.
Video clip showing the TV turning on, changing inputs, and playing a video.
response.reason: The TV is identifiable as a Samsung smart TV, but the model, QLED, and 4K claims cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks like screen damage, non-functionality, or misrepresentation affect pricing. Proof is needed to confirm the model and condition before pricing.
